subject.title: Bug: reasoning selection can validate against the previous model

question: Should model/reasoning ordering be guaranteed by the Gateway for every client, with clients only adding UI pending-state gating, or should each client independently serialize these mutations?
rationale: The report covers Control UI, macOS, iOS, and Android, so a client-only repair risks leaving sibling surfaces inconsistent; the permanent owner boundary needs explicit confirmation.

options.title: Gateway-Owned Ordering
options.body: Serialize validation and persistence per session in the Gateway, then have clients await pending setting requests before sending messages.

options.title: Client-Owned Queues
options.body: Add independent model/reasoning/send queues to every client while leaving Gateway request concurrency unchanged.

recommendation.title: Gateway-Owned Ordering
recommendation.body: Serialize validation and persistence per session in the Gateway, then have clients await pending setting requests before sending messages.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the prior cross-Gateway/Control-UI model-aware thinking work in b3db7c6.
